intro:
An indeterminate loading indicator.

[Button](/docs/components/button) renders one for you when `loading` is set, so a button does not need one passed in.

When you know how much is left, use [Progress](/docs/components/progress) instead.

examples.title: Inside a button
examples.description: You rarely need this — `Button`’s own `loading` prop inserts a variant-matched spinner for you.
